title: Part Nine: What Was in It for Them

sections.brief: Israel's side: Begin and the 1980 Jabotinsky medal to Falwell, Tanenbaum's 1981 critique; Netanyahu's January 1998 Washington meeting with Falwell, Dermer 2021; Christian tourism counts (2008, 2013, 2019, 2024); IFCJ ($1.4-1.5bn, MinistryWatch critique), Hagee Ministries $100m, IAF caucuses; the 2025 $4.1m church campaign and Show Faith by Works; stated reasons vs critics. Figures: stats; time

US side: white evangelical vote 2016-2024 by three measures (CNN exit, Pew, CES) with caveats; Trump 'That's for the evangelicals' (17 Aug 2020) as stated reason, not proof of cause; prophecy book sales and IFCJ fundraising economy; no named-source revenue for pastor ministries; Adelson gifts to CUFI and Maccabee (+972 from filings) and election spending; motive arguments Posner vs CUFI (Morgenstern, Brog), not adjudicated. Figures: stats; money; compare
